subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Crowdsourced Delivery
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Crowdsourced Delivery.

hook.text: Your neighbor drives past your house daily. What if they dropped off your package on the way? That's the idea.

buildup.text: Crowdsourced delivery uses non-professional drivers—gig workers—to deliver packages using their own vehicles.

discovery.text: It scales instantly during demand peaks without owning trucks or hiring permanent drivers.

twist.text: Quality control is harder. Untrained drivers may mishandle packages or miss delivery windows.

climax.text: Amazon Flex uses 200,000+ gig drivers. DoorDash and Uber have expanded into package delivery too.

punchline.text: Anyone with a car can be a delivery driver. Flex labor scales.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of crowdsourced delivery?
